sections.h1: About Vision Graphics New York: Custom Signs for NYC Businesses
sections.lead_html:
Vision Graphics New York is how Vision Graphics serves New York City businesses.

We are a 60-year visual communications company that designs and makes custom signs NYC owners and property managers rely on, and we manage installation through licensed partners.

Send a photo, and we will start your quote.

items.title: One Contact
items.text: A project lead from photo to install

sections.html:
Our roots go back to 1966, when Robert and Diane Shupe started Service Blue, a blueprint business, in their family basement. Over six decades, it grew into Vision Graphics, a large-format and signage producer with a production facility in Salt Lake City.

We expanded across Utah and Nevada, then beyond. In 2024, Banner Capital Management became our growth partner, and Queen of Wraps and 1Source have since joined the Vision Graphics family.

We serve brands nationwide. For New York City clients, that history means the production depth to handle one sign or a multi-location program, with the same standards on every job.

sections.intro_html: We make most signs at our Salt Lake City production facility and ship them to your project. Specialty items can come from other Vision Graphics locations or trusted partners.

items.title: Production You Can Ask About
items.html: Our team handles large-format printing, finishing, and fabrication, and can share equipment and material details for your sign. Ask our team about materials, equipment, and lead times.

items.title: Checked Before It Ships.
items.html: We check every piece against the drawing you approved. What leaves our facility matches what you signed off.

items.title: Packed and Shipped to Your Project
items.html: We pack signs for transit and ship them to your NYC address or installer. We plan transit time into your schedule, so installation dates line up with delivery.

sections.h2: How We Install in New York City
sections.intro_html: Licensed installation partners handle your New York City installation. The city requires a licensed sign hanger for most installs, and we manage the schedule from delivery to final mounting.

items.title: Licensed Partners
items.html: Installers with the right licenses for NYC. A licensed sign hanger installs your sign, and a licensed electrician makes the final connection on lit signs. We prepare the permit paperwork and coordinate the licensed filer.

items.title: Insurance
items.html: We can provide a certificate of insurance upon request. Buildings set their own coverage requirements, so our team confirms yours before work starts.

items.title: Building Access and After-Hours Work
items.html:
We schedule installs around your building's rules. That includes evenings, weekends, and freight elevator windows, and we confirm any added labor charges in your quote.

See how we handle installation in New York City.

sections.h2: Ready to Talk About Your Sign?
sections.html: Send a photo of your storefront, lobby, or office wall and tell us the address. Our team will come back with questions, a drawing, and a quote.

A Vision Graphics project lead is your single point of contact from the first photo to the final install.

Your lead keeps drawings, approvals, and schedule in one place, so you always know who to call.

Questions about site visits, meetings, references,s or building requirements go to our team, and they will answer them.

sections.intro_html: Projects shown here come from other Vision Graphics locations, and each is labeled with its city. Our work appears in stadiums, restaurants, retail spaces, and events across the country. See more on our projects page.

items.title: Independent Businesses
items.html: One sign or a full storefront refresh, started from a photo. We handle design, production, and installation coordination so you don't have to manage multiple vendors.

items.title: Office and Property Programs
items.html: Lobby, suite, and tenant signage kept consistent across a building or a portfolio. We plan landlord approvals and building access from the start.

items.title: Multi-Location Brands
items.html: Consistent brand programs with coordinated production and installation across sites. One set of drawings and finishes follows every location.
